name: Fit Shichao! ~Toshiue Josei to Asedaku Lesson Hatsutaiken~
original_name: フィットしちゃお！ ～年上女性と 汗だくレッスン初体験～
source:
I am a college student aiming for professional instructor.
By the time the school begins its summer vacation,
I was asked to be a part-time trainer in the gym.

The contact person is Mao, a cousin who runs a fitness gym.
It has been several years since we last contacted each other.
So, I was supposed to start my part time job by living in Mao-chan's apartment.
As naturally swept that away, I became the exclusive trainer for female members.
Really!?
Because of the trauma of the past, I do not get along with women,
My older sister cousin, Mao seems to have prepared that solution so that I can overcome it...

Some women have a very weak-willed, others are rebellious women.
Can I respond to their expectation to become an ideal figure?
Although I do not get along well with women yet, can I overcome myself!!??

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962380/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我是一名大学生，目标是成为专业健身教练。
学校即将放暑假时，我收到邀请，要去健身房担任兼职教练。

联系我的，是经营健身房的表姐摩央。
我们已经有好几年没联络了。
于是，我住进摩央姐的公寓，准备开始打工。
不知不觉间，我竟成了女性会员的专属教练。
真的假的？！
因为过去的心理创伤，我一直不擅长与女性相处。
表姐摩央似乎为此准备了办法，想帮我克服这个问题……

这些女性中，有人缺乏毅力，也有人个性叛逆。
我能回应她们的期待，帮助她们练出理想的身材吗？
依然不善于和女性相处的我，又能否突破自己呢？！
